name: Gradient Estimation on BCC Grids
definition: Two gradient reconstruction schemes evaluated for Body-Centered Cubic (BCC) grids to approximate gradients for volume rendering, compared against central differences on Cartesian grids.
summary: Gradient Estimation on BCC Grids provides algorithms to approximate volume gradients on Body-Centered Cubic lattices, distinguishing itself by evaluating specialized BCC estimators against standard Cartesian central differences.
